doc.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995

title: Duets and goodbyes
summary: The two musicians perform a few duets, Rowe thanks them on behalf of Hamilton College, and they wrap up.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: All right. We’ll look in our history books. Well are we going to hear a little music? We’ll pause here for a minute.
I think I’m going to stand though. You still have the camera running?
[Spiegle and Al perform a few duets.]
That was good, even if I have to say so myself.
On behalf of Hamilton College I want to thank you gentlemen, Al Gallodoro and Spiegele Willcox. That was beautiful and the instrument thing put it over the top. Thank you very much.
Someday you’ll say, “My God I’ll never forget that. We did that 30 years ago in ’95.”
We tried. At least I didn’t squeak on the clarinet. © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-
